summary: 改写 4 条不实注释（第一批谱系形态 #5『虚构/过期的待办状态』的逆形态：把『任务落地前』写成现在式——pairing-security 与 state-parser/fix-state-wiring 均已落地但做的是别的事，原注释声称它们会替换掉本包的默认实现，实际 cmd/agentmirrord 仍用 staticToken/unknownState 默认 + Options 装配）；补 9 个 @contract（NewServer/Server.Close/Server.Handler/NewStateProvider/wiredStateProvider.Close/State/StateProvider.State/TokenValidator.ValidateToken/Discoverer.Discover）；消 4 条 T3-4 漂移（internal/agentstate、internal/bridge、internal/discovery、internal/protocol）。已做阳性对照（删 NewServer 的 @err → 单包硬判 exit 1 精确指向 server.go:72，改回后恢复 exit 0）。

tests.note: 单包硬判全绿（T3-1/T3-2/T3-3/T3-4 均 PASS）

tests.note: 全仓库判据 exit 0；剩余 T3-1(1)/T3-4(24) 均为他包（Kotlin dev.agentmirror.app.* 与 cmd/agentmirrord），internal/api 条目已清零

changes: server/internal/api/doc.go — 包级 doc 补充 agentstate 消费说明；新增 4 个独立 @consumes 声明块（internal/agentstate/bridge/discovery/protocol）
server/internal/api/options.go — 文件头与 TokenValidator/StateProvider 字段 doc 从『a later task replaces』改为落地事实（staticToken/unknownState 默认 + pairing 生成 token + fix-state-wiring 装配）
server/internal/api/state.go — StateProvider 接口 doc 从『state-parser task lands the real implementation』改为 wiredStateProvider 装配事实；State 方法补 @contract
server/internal/api/token.go — TokenValidator 接口 doc 从『pairing-security task replaces』改为 pairing 生成 token 不替换验证器的事实；ValidateToken 补 @contract

rewritten.old: // The state-parser task lands the real implementation; the default always returns protocol.StateUnknown
rewritten.untrue: state-parser 任务已落地（taskbook 有 state-parser.json 证据）且产出的是 agentstate 包（规则/识别），不是『本接口的实现』；生产实现 wiredStateProvider 由 fix-state-wiring 任务装配（main.go:116 NewStateProvider → Options.StateProvider），不属于 state-parser。原注释把任务归属与实现路径都说错了。
rewritten.basis: taskbook.yaml 85-95（state-parser 目标=per-agent 适配器，write_scope=internal/agentstate）；taskbook.yaml 317-327（fix-state-wiring 装配 agentstate→api.Options.StateProvider）；main.go:116,122-130；state_wiring.go NewStateProvider
rewritten.new: // The production implementation is wiredStateProvider (state_wiring.go), assembled by NewStateProvider and handed to the api server by cmd/agentmirrord (task fix-state-wiring); a caller that wires no provider gets unknownState, which always returns protocol.StateUnknown (requirement 008 first-class value).

rewritten.old: // The pairing-security task replaces the default static-token implementation with a real pairing flow; until then the daemon validates against the token configured at startup.
rewritten.untrue: pairing-security 已落地（pairing 包生成 token），但没有『替换 staticToken』——cmd/agentmirrord 仍以 Options.Token 注入静态 token，main.go 的 Options.Token: token 一行即是装配；staticToken 仍是唯一实现。原注释把『未来任务会替换默认』当现状，而实际上任务落地后做的事不是替换。
rewritten.basis: taskbook.yaml 97-106（pairing-security 目标=服务端生成 token+WS 校验）；main.go:96-100（resolveToken 生成/复用 token）、main.go:122-130（Options.Token: token）；token.go staticToken
rewritten.new: // The default is staticToken, validating in constant time against the token configured at startup (Options.Token); the seam stays so a future pairing flow can plug in without touching auth frame handling. pairing generates the token itself (task pairing-security); it does not replace this validator — cmd/agentmirrord wires the resolved token in via Options.Token.

rewritten.old: // It is the seam the pairing-security task replaces with a real pairing flow; the default validates against Options.Token.
rewritten.untrue: 同上——pairing-security 没有替换默认，默认仍是 staticToken；字段 doc 把任务落地效果写成了『替换 seam』。
rewritten.new: // The default is staticToken, validating against Options.Token in constant time; the seam stays for a future pairing flow. pairing generates the token itself (task pairing-security), it does not replace this validator.

rewritten.old: // The default always returns protocol.StateUnknown (requirement 008 first-class value); the state-parser task lands the real provider and the wiring is a later integration.
rewritten.untrue: wiring 已落地（fix-state-wiring 在 main.go:116-130 完成 NewStateProvider→Options.StateProvider 装配），不是『later integration』；state-parser 产出 agentstate 包，不是本字段的实现。
rewritten.new: // The default is unknownState, always returning protocol.StateUnknown (requirement 008 first-class value); the production wiring is wiredStateProvider via NewStateProvider, assembled by cmd/agentmirrord (task fix-state-wiring). State failures must never affect mirroring or input — this interface is the seam that guarantees it.
